input.new_string:
const totals = {}

    const enriched = positions.map((p) => {
      const q = quoteMap[p.ticker] || {}
      const currency = p.ticker.toUpperCase().endsWith('.TA') ? 'ILS' : 'USD'
      const currentPrice = q.price || 0
      const value = currentPrice * p.shares
      const cost = p.avgCost * p.shares
      const pnl = value - cost
      const pnlPercent = cost > 0 ? (pnl / cost) * 100 : 0

      if (!totals[currency]) totals[currency] = { value: 0, cost: 0 }
      totals[currency].value += value
      totals[currency].cost += cost

      return {
        _id: p._id,
        ticker: p.ticker,
        currency,
        companyName: q.name || p.companyName,
        shares: p.shares,
        avgCost: p.avgCost,
        currentPrice,
        value,
        cost,
        pnl,
        pnlPercent,
        change: q.change,
        changePercent: q.changePercent,
      }
    })

    const totalsArray = Object.entries(totals).map(([currency, t]) => ({
      currency,
      value: t.value,
      cost: t.cost,
      pnl: t.value - t.cost,
      pnlPercent: t.cost > 0 ? ((t.value - t.cost) / t.cost) * 100 : 0,
    }))

    res.json({ positions: enriched, totals: totalsArray })
input.old_string:
let totalValue = 0
    let totalCost = 0

    const enriched = positions.map((p) => {
      const q = quoteMap[p.ticker] || {}
      const currentPrice = q.price || 0
      const value = currentPrice * p.shares
      const cost = p.avgCost * p.shares
      const pnl = value - cost
      const pnlPercent = cost > 0 ? (pnl / cost) * 100 : 0
      totalValue += value
      totalCost += cost
      return {
        _id: p._id,
        ticker: p.ticker,
        companyName: q.name || p.companyName,
        shares: p.shares,
        avgCost: p.avgCost,
        currentPrice,
        value,
        cost,
        pnl,
        pnlPercent,
        change: q.change,
        changePercent: q.changePercent,
      }
    })

    res.json({
      positions: enriched,
      totalValue,
      totalCost,
      totalPnl: totalValue - totalCost,
      totalPnlPercent: totalCost > 0 ? ((totalValue - totalCost) / totalCost) * 100 : 0,
    })
